summary: Bug fix verification: product details bottom sticky bar (safe-area overlap). VERIFIED FIXED. Tested on web preview (insets.bottom=0): footer sits flush at viewport bottom (bottom=844px=viewport height, height 79px, white opaque bg), PRICE label + price (510 L) + add/stepper all fully visible and unobstructed. Code review confirms fix correctly applied in /app/frontend/app/product/[id].tsx: useSafeAreaInsets() + paddingBottom: Math.max(spacing.lg, insets.bottom + 8), ScrollView paddingBottom 140+insets.bottom, SafeAreaView edges=['top']. Qty stepper fully functional: add->1, increment->2, decrement->1 (backend cart sync working). Product page regression: hero image, unit chip, name, brand, price, description all render; prod-back works in natural navigation flow. Regression on other bottom bars: checkout Place order bar fully visible (bottom=844, h=91), address-picker Use this address bar fully visible, category floating View cart bar also fully visible. No console errors observed.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix in product/[id].tsx is correct and matches the pattern already used in checkout.tsx (footerBar) and address-picker.tsx (bottomSheet): Math.max(spacing.lg, insets.bottom + 8).

All interactive elements have testIDs; styles use StyleSheet.create; text wrapped in Text. No deprecated expo packages observed in reviewed files.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: footer in product/[id].tsx was position:absolute bottom:0 with fixed padding, so on Android devices with 3-button navigation the system nav bar overlapped the footer, greying it out. Root cause: footer ignored bottom safe-area inset and SafeAreaView had edges ['top','bottom'] which conflicted with the absolutely positioned footer (absolute positioning ignores parent padding). Fix: useSafeAreaInsets() + dynamic paddingBottom on footer, ScrollView paddingBottom includes insets.bottom, edges changed to ['top'] only. Verified: footer bottom edge exactly at viewport bottom on web (insets=0) with all content visible; on Android the Math.max(spacing.lg, insets.bottom + 8) padding lifts content above the system nav.
